notes.title: Year of the Snake Second Big Update Released!!
notes.content:
Hello players, the second major update version of the Year of the Snake is officially released!!

A note about what's new:
1. Plot.
(1) Re-revised the hostess.,Overall, the silly white sweetness is -50% again on the basis of last year's update.,The heroine expresses a lot of her own opinions.,But it's still kind.。
(2) In response to the controversial Furukawa Hibiki Line and Nikita Line, the Nikita Line was rewritten, and Furukawa Hibikiya's character design was revised, and many dialogues were reconstructed.
(3) Historical events are more clearly expressed, and the Riddler has improved dramatically.
(4) The remaining lines are subject to change according to the heroine's character correction.
(5) The conditions for entering the line have been modified. The Nikita line was changed to "do not respond" and the Guan Yan line was changed to "give".
🌟 There are no changes to the plot direction and key events based on historical facts.
2. Music. Fixed BGM gigs.
3. Due to the addition of a large number of descriptions of historical events, the political content and bloody descriptions have increased, if there is a part that does not meet your heart, please close the game immediately.
4. In order to avoid bugs, players who want to re-experience the story should delete the savedata folder in the game folder (the location is steam-common-steamapps-tide—1927-savedata in C or D disks
Skip the read story by fast-forwarding it, and don't click on an existing save file.

🌟 The nature of the sequel: Fan Disc "Tide-1932-", I hope you will support it!!

From the author's note:
This game is made independently by the author.,Of course, there are many immature places in the initial release.,The original intention of multiple updates is to hope that the story can be told better.,I hope that all players Haihan.。
If you think the game still has merit, I hope you have a lot of Amway, thank you to every player who likes this game!!

notes.title: Big update version public!!
notes.content:
Hello players, "Tide - 1927 -" major update version is officially released, tomorrow will enter a two-week 20%off promotion.

A note on the content of this update:
1. Plot aspect. Add 3w+ text, reedit 8w+ text, where each line has a new event, and add the motive of the heroine trying to whitewash herself; New story patches have been added for certain characters, including a post-day talk and a pre-day talk.
🌟 There is no change in the direction of the plot or the key events. 
2. Art. Added 50 images without small differences (25 of which are CG included in appreciation), corrected most of the separate painting and some CG.
3. Music. Added a new BGM and fixed the BGM performance.
4.UI. Reworked the entire UI and recompiled the dictionary content.
5. The full-screen function has been added, but due to the incompatibility between the engine and win10, there may be vicious black screen of death bug, the system setting screen has written the memo, please do not open the full screen easily if the screen ratio is not 16:9.
6. The political content and bloody description of this game have increased, if there is any part that does not meet your mind, please close the game immediately.
7. Open the live, live and recorded content of hidden lines from the date of the announcement.
8. To avoid bugs, please delete the savedata folder in the game folder (steam-common-steamapps-tide -- 1927 -- savedata on disk C or D) if you want to replay the story
), skip the read story by fast forward, do not easily click on the existing archive.

From the author:
This game is independently produced by the author and is not suitable for players who have high requirements for the game. If you feel that it is not fun, please close it immediately.
The authors plan to learn the code from scratch and later add the achievement system.
If you think the game is still desirable, I hope many Amway, thank every player who likes this game!!

notes.title: Free end for a limited time!!
notes.content:
The game officially ends on October 12 and is free for a limited time, currently priced at $2.99 / ￥18.
A note on recent game content updates:
1. Content has been updated. Several minor updates have been uploaded to the game since its release date, including: revisions to vertical drawing and CG, revisions to BGM performance, minor patches to story logic, and partial performance revisions. If the prologue code is modified, the prologue archive may be unavailable. For example, it is suggested to delete the archive, restart the game, and fast forward the prologue.
2. Future updates. New events and CG are planned, achievements are added, and the story is rewritten to some extent. If a major version update is carried out, the save will be unavailable because the new story does not correspond to the save, please pay attention to the player. Archiving issues will be notified again when a major update is released.
